data.gender_notes: Janhita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Janhita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jnana', meaning 'knowledge'. The prefix 'ita' means 'residing in'. Thus, Janhita is the name of a goddess who is believed to reside in the realm of knowledge. The name Janhita carries the meaning “Goddess of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Janhita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Janhita total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
